description: A slender reef shark with a short, broad, flattened head, a blunt snout and small oval eyes. Its grey-brown back carries small dark spots, and the first dorsal fin and upper tail lobe have white tips. It hunts at night, wedging into crevices and caves for fish, octopus and crustaceans, and rests on the bottom by day.
depth: Surface to about 330 m, usually 8 to 40 m
eats: Fish, octopus, spiny lobsters and crabs
